contact.title_en: Software Engineer | AI, Robotics & Systems Integration
contact.title_zh: 軟體工程師｜AI、機器人與系統整合

summary.en: Software Engineer with an M.S. in Electrical Engineering, experienced in frontend/backend platforms, AI services, and robotics software from requirements and architecture through Docker deployment, testing, and real-world integration. Skilled in Python, C++, C#/.NET, React/TypeScript, FastAPI, WebSocket, ROS 2, Isaac Sim/Lab, Isaac GR00T, computer vision, and Digital Twin workflows.
summary.zh: 軟體工程師，具電機工程碩士背景，能從需求分析、系統架構、開發、測試、Docker 部署到現場整合交付前後端平台、AI 服務與機器人軟體。熟悉 Python、C++、C#／.NET、React／TypeScript、FastAPI、WebSocket、ROS 2、Isaac Sim／Lab、Isaac GR00T、電腦視覺與 Digital Twin 資料流程。

experience.company_zh: 瑞軒科技股份有限公司

en: Owned software delivery from requirements and system architecture through frontend/backend implementation, Docker deployment, testing, on-site integration, and maintenance for AI and robotics systems.

Built a Next.js / React Flow / FastAPI / WebSocket workflow and data-recording platform for automated task execution and AI / VLA data workflows, reaching approximately 3-4x the manual data volume in the same time window and reducing manual staffing needs by two operators.

Built a React / TypeScript / FastAPI / ROS 2 web control and monitoring platform with real-time feedback, video, system status, control commands, and Docker / Nginx deployment; improved cable-insertion success from 70% to 90%.

Integrated ROS 2 control and simulation, Isaac GR00T N1.7 data conversion, model training, policy inference, visual perception, and PatchCore anomaly detection across simulation and physical-robot workflows.
zh: 獨立負責 AI 與機器人軟體從需求、系統架構、前後端開發到 Docker 部署、測試、現場整合與維護。
以 Next.js、React Flow、FastAPI、WebSocket 與 Docker 建置自動化工作流程與資料錄製平台，支援 AI／VLA 資料流程；相同時間內資料蒐集量約為人工操作的 3～4 倍，並節省兩名操作人力。
以 React、TypeScript、FastAPI、ROS 2、WebSocket 與 Docker／Nginx 建置 Web 控制與監控平台，整合即時回饋、影像、系統狀態與控制命令，將線材插接成功率由 70% 提升至 90%。
整合 ROS 2 控制與模擬、Isaac GR00T N1.7 資料轉換、模型訓練、Policy Inference、視覺感知與 PatchCore 異常檢測，涵蓋虛擬與真實機器人流程。
